topic: Passenger compartment reading lamp configuration for different seat configurations
row_semantics: Different passenger seat configurations (Five-seat and Six-seat)

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the configuration parameters for reading lamps in the passenger compartment based on the vehicle's seat configuration. It specifies which lamps are present (by LampID and position) and whether voice control is supported. This information is crucial for testing the correct activation/deactivation logic of reading lamps under different seat configurations and verifying voice control functionality.
